description: MUTATES one Food Diary row the authenticated user owns by storing a meal photo on it (same pipeline as the web diary upload). Required: food_id (UUID from log_food / search) plus exactly one of image_base64 (raw base64 or data: URL) or url (public http/https image). JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, or AVIF under 8 MB. One photo per entry: calling again replaces photo_url (replaced/previous_photo_url report it). EXIF capture time moves consumed_at unless keep_consumed_at=true. Unknown or other-user food_id returns not_found and stores nothing. Response photo_url is re-read from the row. Syncs the mirrored calendar event and rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.15; API key required)

food_id.description: UUID of a Food Diary row the authenticated user owns

image_base64.description: Image bytes as base64 (optional data:image/...;base64, prefix). Use this or url.

keep_consumed_at.description: true keeps the entry time even if the photo EXIF has a capture time

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

url.description: Public http(s) image URL to fetch and store. Use this or image_base64.

name: attach_food_photo

consumed_at_changed.description: True when photo EXIF moved the entry time.

photo_url.description: Stored photo URL, re-read from the Food Diary row.

replaced.description: True when the entry already had a photo.

title: Attach Food Photo (Food Diary photo)
